description: This file declares the TrialComparisonCertVerifier class, a specialized CertVerifier used for comparing the results of two different certificate verification processes within the Chromium project. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and callback mechanisms for reporting differences.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier
classes.description: A CertVerifier that compares verification results between two CertVerifyProcs and reports differences via a callback.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the verifier with factory, fetcher, parameters, and report callback.

methods.name: trial_allowed
methods.description: Returns whether trial verification is allowed.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, dispatching to primary and trial verifiers.

methods.name: SetConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the verifier.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for verifier events.

methods.name: UpdateVerifyProcData
methods.description: Updates verification process data with fetcher and parameters.

methods.name: NotifyJobsOfConfigChange
methods.description: Notifies background jobs of configuration changes.

methods.name: ProcessImplParams
methods.description: Processes implementation parameters for primary and trial verifiers.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the certificate verifier.
